subject: Tenant cutover: staged rollback plan & ops readiness
messages:
From: Simon Lewis <simon.lewis@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-27T09:10:00-08:00
Subject: Cutover plan + smoke tests for Pioneer private deploy

Hi Mina,

We’re aiming to do the tenant cutover the week of Dec 8 and wanted a single consolidated checklist and the proposed rollback/staged-cutover approach. Key asks from our side:
- We need a low-risk plan (ideally zero-downtime but we can accept short, staged maintenance windows)
- Clear firewall/egress entries to provide to our network team
- A concise smoke test matrix so our SREs can validate post-cutover
- Names of Redwood on-call contacts for the cutover window

Can you share the runbook and confirm whether Redwood supports a staged rollback per-service (not full tenant rollback)? Also please confirm any prerequisites the Pioneer infra team must complete before the cutover (e.g., service account, KMS access, DNS owners).

Thanks,
Simon
Simon Lewis
Head of Infrastructure, Pioneer Health
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Simon Lewis <simon.lewis@pioneerhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-27T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cutover plan + smoke tests for Pioneer private deploy

Hi Simon — thanks for the checklist request. Attached is a compact runbook and a smoke-test playbook that map to Redwood’s private deployment procedures. High level summary here so your network team can start work immediately: 

Prereqs (customer responsibilities)
- Service account: create a dedicated service account with the provided email (we’ll send the exact principal)
- KMS access: grant decrypt/encrypt to our service account for the staging key\n- Firewall/Egress: allow outbound to these hostnames/IPs and ports (attached CSV)
- DNS: ability to add a CNAME for the inference endpoint (we provide tenant-specific values)
- Bastion/jump: open SSH from our cutover engineer IP to the management bastion (time-boxed)

Our recommended staged cutover
- Stage 0: Pre-cutover sanity (inventory, credentials, KV cache priming) — 30m
- Stage 1: Redirect small percentage of traffic (10%) — 15m smoke
- Stage 2: Increase to 50% traffic — 15m smoke
- Stage 3: Full traffic shift with post-cutover verification — 30m

Rollback model
- We support per-route/model rollback via the routing policy: we can revert rollouts per model variant which avoids full tenant rollback. The attached runbook has the exact rollback commands and the fallback timeouts.

On-call and owners
- Primary Redwood cutover lead: Mina Haddad (mina_haddad@redwood.ai)
- Ops escalation (bastion/KMS): Ben Carter
- Network/egress validation: Karthik Iyer

I’ve attached: redwood-staged-cutover-runbook.pdf and smoke-test-playbook.md and exported the egress list as pioneer-egress-allowlist.csv. Please confirm your availability window (we recommend a weekday early-morning PST slot to minimize traffic).

If that looks good I’ll loop in Ben and Karthik to confirm the exact run-of-show and engineering owners.

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-27T11:15:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Cutover plan + smoke tests for Pioneer private deploy — review + owners

Team — forwarding Simon’s note and the runbook I prepared. Please review the attached runbook and smoke tests. Quick asks: 
- Ben: confirm the exact bastion ACL and if we need a temporary elevated session user for the cutover (we prefer time-limited certs)
- Karthik: confirm we can do per-route rollback for the model variants Pioneer will use (they’ll be using quantized-1 and float32-2 variants)
- Grace: can you own the post-cutover validation checklist and coordinate with Pioneer SRE for the smoke window?

I’m proposing a 2-hour window broken into stages (see runbook page 3). If you see any critical gaps, flag them here.

Attachments: redwood-staged-cutover-runbook.pdf, smoke-test-playbook.md

Thanks — Mina
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-27T13:06:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Cutover plan + smoke tests for Pioneer private deploy — review + owners

Mina / team — reviewed the runbook. A couple of operational notes and small edits I’ll push to the doc: 
- Bastion: we’ll provide a short-lived cert with a 3-hour TTL that Pioneer ops can use. Request: provide the source IPs so we can pre-authorize in the firewall.
- KMS: we’ll need Pioneer to create a cross-account IAM role with decrypt permission; instructions are in the appendix.
- Traffic steering: confirm whether Pioneer wants weighted routing (our preferred) or connection-level cutover; weighted routing avoids connection churn.
- Smoke window sizing: 15m per stage is fine for small traffic; recommend adding an automated tokened probe that verifies key inference paths (we included a probe script in smoke-test-playbook.md)

I’m good to be primary ops for the cutover day. Karthik, can you confirm per-model rollback works for the two mentioned variants and we’ll insert a rollback checklist item in the runbook?

I’ve attached a short diff (internal) but I’ll update the shared runbook link after Karthik confirms the rollback model.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Infrastructure Lead, Redwood Inference
From: Simon Lewis <simon.lewis@pioneerhealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: network-team@pioneerhealth.com
Date: 2025-11-28T14:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Cutover plan + smoke tests for Pioneer private deploy

Thanks Mina and Ben — this looks good and exactly the level of detail we needed. Confirming:
- Pioneer can provide the source IPs (see attached pioneer-egress-allowlist.csv) and we can provision the cross-account role for KMS by Dec 3.
- We prefer weighted routing for the cutover.
- Proposed window: Dec 9, 06:00–08:00 PST. Our SREs (cc’d) will run the smoke checks in collaboration with Grace.

We’re happy with per-route rollback. Please add a short pre-cutover checklist item for our DNS owner (who will add the CNAME 5m before Stage 1).

I’ll sign the DocuSign envelope after we finalize the small contract addendum.

Best,
Simon
Simon Lewis
Head of Infrastructure, Pioneer Health
